question: Who was Gianluigi Donnarumma whose name was seen in news in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sportsperson**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gianluigi Donnarumma **is an** Italian footballer **who plays as a** goalkeeper** for Italy national team.
 
• He also plays for** Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **In News__**

 
• Donnarumma **saved 2 penalties in the Euro cup 2020** final against England.
 
• He was crowned **Euro 2020 Player of the Tournament.**
 
• He has joined **Paris Saint-Germain **on a **five-year deal **after leaving Serie A club AC Milan on a free transfer.
